description: Label and group Java ecosystem updates, keeping majors in their own PR and separating the build tool and parent POM from application dependencies

packageRules.description: Group non-major Java updates into a single PR
Maven build plugins and Gradle plugins are build infrastructure rather than application dependencies, so group them separately
A parent POM bump changes the managed version of everything it governs, so it gets its own PR rather than being grouped

The Gradle and Maven wrappers pin the build tool itself, which is a toolchain change. Majors are included because the maven-wrapper manager emits both the Maven distribution and the wrapper jar, and those must move together
